AWS\> 群組

1.user\>accesskey 2.policy\>S3 full access

封裝成docker \>run image\> 上傳至公司docker hub\>ec2驗證網頁功能

新增[AmazonS3FullAccess](https://us-east-1.console.aws.amazon.com/iam/home?region=ap-east-2#/policies/details/arn%3Aaws%3Aiam%3A%3Aaws%3Apolicy%2FAmazonS3FullAccess) \>角色名稱custom\_role\>role asigned給ec2

ec2 下載docker,抓取docker hub上之分支版本\>啟動時加上\-e S3\_BUCKET\_NAME="ckc101-27" 環境變數 										AWS\_DEFAULT\_REGION="ap-east-2"
